capital.T_sizing: floor(cash*0.30/(T native close*1.21)/100)*100; no future open in sizing
capital.cash_dividend_booking: Existing P2 applies qualified per-share cash at native ex_date. Payment-date receivables/dividend tax timing are outside this fixed-source counterfactual.
capital.holding: enter T+1 open after T close signal; fixed exit signal T+1 close, first legal sell T+2 open; carry same sell order
capital.ranking_precision: sample std formula unchanged, rounded to12 decimals for reproducible ranking, ties by opaque listing_id
capital.terminal: mark open holdings using qualified 2021-12-31 close and report right-censoring; no forced fill or 2022 read
capital.unknown_action_date: An IMPLEMENTED action without ex_date excludes that security from new entries and blocks any held consumption over this frozen window; observed effective_at is not substituted as event date.
capital.year_return: calendar-year system wealth change divided by fixed initial100000; trades grouped by exit year

branches.advance: supported as a candidate for subsequent independent robustness validation
branches.blocked: not_evaluated; stop affected comparison and preserve the exact input/semantic discrepancy
branches.not_met: sample sufficient and candidate net return<=0 OR net increment<=0; park this fixed holding use

decision.primary: candidate minus control ending-system-wealth net return

scope.purpose: fixed guarded capital counterfactual with exact qualified P10 cash-purpose input
scope.simulation_clock: quanthus.capital-retrospective-clock.v2; simulated T-close business clock distinct from unchanged native source clocks and genuinely new P10 interpretation/qualification clock
scope.source_clock: preserve original knowledge_from/to and announced/effective clocks; historical publication qualification not granted

screen.control: baseline AND finite momentum20 outside original closed band
screen.listing_age_rule: calendar open sessions since listing effective_from; start clipped to 2019 for older listings, guaranteed >=120 before first decision
screen.next_open_rule: next open calendar_session joined by venue; valid listing/security [from,to), positive finite open, tradable and can_buy true, positive finite upper limit, open < upper-0.005
screen.unknown_rule: missing/invalid required input blocks admission; disjoint ordered reason ledger
screen.volatility_formula: sample_std(close_t/close_tminus1-1 over current20)*sqrt(252); 21 consecutive positive finite closes; excludes corporate action adjustment
